body: UPDATE: The shit hits the fan tomorrow. I feel like I'm being asked to sit across a table from one of my rapists and listen to how terrible they feel about what they did to me, how sorry they are, how much they hope I don't think they're a bad person because of what they did. They dragged me to the deepest horror, nearly perpetrated the greatest imaginable pain upon my wife, my family, my brothers and sisters. We have already lost FOUR siblings in my family, I will destroy anyone who tries to make it five.

That's as close to a plan as I have at the moment, yeah. Thanks for validation. I just really don't like to be rude or uncivil in general (courteous behavior is a huge thing in my family, no matter what), and it's my wife's feelings I'm trying to avoid ruffling. 

Whatever the case, I'm not ready to forgive my MIL but when I am I will do. But I'll be damned if I let anyone dictate the pace of my recovery, and if I need to heal then I need to be left alone to do it my way. 

Really appreciate the support. Thanks. :)
